title: Event Envelope
description: The wire contract for a single event as it crosses the bus. Every runtime MUST emit and accept this shape so the control plane re-enters identically wherever an agent ran. The runtime enum MUST stay equal to the dispatcher's routable runtime set (see runtimes.source).

trace_id.description: Correlation id carried across local and remote steps of one run.

agent.description: Short id of the emitting agent; matches the registry.

event.description: Event type / output status; drives subscription routing.

runtime.description: Where the emitting agent executed. Must equal the dispatcher's routable runtime set.

pipeline_mode.description: Run mode, set once at phase 0; read-only downstream.

confidence_score.description: Decision agents emit 0-100; null/absent for infra agents.

payload.description: Agent-specific body. Opaque to the bus; validated against the per-event schema separately.
